ruleDefinitions.name: Visual Studio Code Tunnel Remote File Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of file by the "node.exe" process in the ".vscode-server" directory. Could be a sign of remote file creation via VsCode tunnel feature

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\servers\\\\Stable\\-.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\server\\\\node\\\.exe$") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\\\\.vscode\\-server\\\\data\\\\User\\\\History\\\\.*"))
